translation_snapshot.source: release a radius %d burst of void energy at up to range %d, dealing %0.2f temporal and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic)
translation_snapshot.target: 在 %d 码范围内释放虚空能量，至多距离 %d。造成 %0.2f 时空和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。（基于魔法）

translation_snapshot.source:
You move through the dream world, reappearing at a nearby location.
		If there is a sleeping creature at the target location, you'll appear as close to them as possible, otherwise, you'll appear within %d tiles of your intended destination.
translation_snapshot.target:
你穿越梦境，出现在某个目标地点附近。
		如果目标为处于睡眠状态的生物，你将会出现在离目标最近的地方。
		否则，你会出现在目标位置的 %d 码范围内。

translation_snapshot.source: #F53CBE#You feel your rampage slowing down. (-1 duration)
translation_snapshot.target: #F53CBE#你感受到你的暴走开始减速。（-1持续时间）

translation_snapshot.source:
Increases all unarmed damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 (including grapples and kicks).
		Note that brawlers naturally gain 0.5 Physical Power per character level while unarmed (current brawler physical power bonus: %0.1f) and attack 20%% faster while unarmed.
translation_snapshot.target:
增加 %d%% 所有徒手伤害，提高 30 物理强度（包括抓取/徒手技）。
		注意：徒手战斗时，格斗家具有随等级每级增加 0.5 物理强度。（当前提高 %0.1f 物理强度）和攻击速度提高 20%% 的固有属性。

translation_snapshot.source: Increases your maximum energy by %d. You also gain %0.1f Psi for each kill and %0.1f Psi for each mind critical.
translation_snapshot.target: 增加灵能值上限 %d。每次杀死敌人获得 %0.1f 灵能值，每次精神暴击获得 %0.1f 灵能值。

translation_snapshot.source: This ugly orc looks really nasty and vicious. He wields a huge two-handed sword and means to use it.
